<!--
  The event intro (model event@1): an optional badge, the name of the event as a large heading, a description,

  or at the start.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type EventIntroProps = {
  id: string;
  badge?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  date: string;
  place: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  badge = "",
  title,
  description = "",
  date,
  place,
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<EventIntroProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const facts = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "justify-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "justify-end"
  : "justify-start"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'

    data-slot="event-intro"

          {{ description }}

        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2', facts))">
          <ListItem data-slot="event-date">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ date }}
            </Text>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem data-slot="event-place">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {{ place }}

          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
          {{ actionLabel }}
        </LinkButton>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
